Theorem
[Existence of harmonic maps into nonpositively curved targets (Theorem K.17)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0365 1. appk:K.17\group Harmonic Map Heat Flow

If $M,N$ are closed and $N$ has nonpositive sectional curvature, every smooth $f_0:M\to N$ is homotopic to a harmonic map. The harmonic map heat flow \[ \partial _tf=\Delta _{g,h}f \] exists for all $t\ge 0$ and converges smoothly to a harmonic map; strict negative curvature gives uniqueness in the homotopy class.
